title: JSON model
text: Nodes with seven shapes or custom SVG, ports, edges with three routings, arrowheads, labels, and groups.

title: Auto-layout
text: Layered flowcharts and trees in four directions, keeping hand-moved steps when you ask.

title: Full editing
text: Palette, drag to move with snap and guides, connect from ports, reconnect, inline labels, copy, paste, undo.

title: Keyboard first
text: Spatial arrow navigation, move mode, a connect flow, and a text alternative listing every connection.

title: Export
text: Theme-matched SVG and PNG files without style attributes, ready to share.
